description: Search file contents (literal or regex) and/or paths (files and dirs); first match per line only. default_exclude_globs noise is skipped unless use_default_excludes: false. truncated: true means refine the query, not paginate. Paths: relative to the primary root or absolute inside an allowed root (see coder::info).

context_lines_after.description: Lines of context after each content match; same rules as `context_lines_before`.

context_lines_before.description: Lines of context before each content match (max 10, C210 above); truncated to max_line_bytes and counted in the budget. Default 0.

exclude_globs.description: Glob patterns (same relative-to-root matching) that exclude paths.

fuzzy_paths.description: Rank path matches by fuzzy subsequence score (quick-open style) instead of substring/regex matching; `path_matches` then comes back best first. Content matching is unaffected.

include_globs.description: Root-relative glob patterns paths must match; empty = everything.

include_hidden.description: Walk dot-files and dot-folders (`.github`, `.env`, …); default true. `false` leaves them out, the way an editor's quick open does.

max_line_bytes.description: Bytes per line to consider when scanning content; longer lines are truncated for the match snippet.

max_matches.description: Optional explicit cap. Falls back to config when unset.

path.description: Folder to search (default `.`); globs match relative to its root, result paths are absolute.

query.description: Pattern to search for. Treated as a regex when `regex: true`, otherwise as a literal substring. May be empty only when `search_content` is false: a path-only search with no query lists every path (with `fuzzy_paths`, shallow and short paths first).

respect_gitignore.description: Honour `.gitignore`/`.ignore` rules (inside a Git repository) while walking, the way an editor's search does; default false keeps every non-excluded file searchable.

use_default_excludes.description: Skip paths matching default_exclude_globs (.git, node_modules, …; see coder::info) in content and path results; false searches inside them.

after.description: Context lines immediately after the matched line — same file only, in file order, each truncated to `max_line_bytes`. Omitted when empty (no `context_lines_after` requested, or the match is at the end of the file).

before.description: Context lines immediately before the matched line — same file only, in file order, each truncated to `max_line_bytes`. Omitted when empty (no `context_lines_before` requested, or the match is at the start of the file).

path.description: Absolute path under the canonical parent; symlinks at the entry itself are not resolved. Operations on it re-validate through the jail.

text.description: Matched line; truncated to `max_line_bytes` and never spans newlines.

kind.description: What matched: `file` or `dir`. Directories match by NAME only — content search never reads them.

path.description: Absolute path under the canonical parent; symlinks at the entry itself are not resolved. Operations on it re-validate through the jail.

truncated.description: True if results were cut off — either match list hit the `max_matches` cap, or the response hit the `search_response_budget_bytes` byte budget. When true, refine the query or add include_globs rather than paginate.
